🎯 Find and Snipe Brainrot
Welcome to Find and Snipe Brainrot!
Step into the role of a skilled sniper roaming the city, hunting down the lurking Brainrot.

🔫 Hunt & Snipe: Track Brainrot across the map and take them down with precision.

💰 Collect & Earn: Capture Brainrot to gain coins and boost your progress.

⚡ Upgrade Weapons: Strengthen your sniper rifle’s damage and unlock powerful gear.

👑 Defeat Higher Levels: Challenge stronger Brainrot and rise to the top as the ultimate city sniper!

Are you ready? Jump in now, sharpen your aim, and build your legend in the fight against Brainrot!
